mapper.select: SELECT M.MBER_NO FROM mber M WHERE M.MBER_ID = #{mberId} AND M.MBER_USE_STTUS = "ACTIVE"
SELECT M.MBER_ID FROM mber M WHERE M.MBER_ID = #{loginId} AND M.MBER_LOGIN_TY ="KAKAO" AND M.MBER_USE_STTUS = "ACTIVE"
SELECT M.MBER_ID FROM mber M WHERE M.MBER_ID = #{loginId} AND M.MBER_LOGIN_TY ="GOOGLE" AND M.MBER_USE_STTUS = "ACTIVE"
SELECT A.AUTHOR_NM AS mberRole , M.* FROM mber M LEFT OUTER JOIN author A ON M.MBER_NO = A.MBER_NO WHERE M.MBER_ID= #{mberId} AND M.MBER_USE_STTUS = "ACTIVE"
SELECT M.REFRESH_TOKEN FROM mber M WHERE M.MBER_ID =#{mberId} AND M.MBER_USE_STTUS = "ACTIVE"

SELECT C.CHLDRN_NO , C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY , C.CHLDRN_SEXDSTN , C.ATCH_CODE , C.CHLDRN_NM , C.CHLDRN_NCNM , CI.CHLDRN_HEIGHT , CI.CHLDRN_BDWGH , CI.CHLDRN_HEAD FROM chldrn C LEFT OUTER JOIN mber_chldrn MC ON MC.CHLDRN_NO = C.CHLDRN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT CI.* FROM chldrn_info CI WHERE CI.CRT_DT = ( SELECT MAX(CRT_DT) FROM chldrn_info WHERE CHLDRN_NO = CI.CHLDRN_NO ) ) CI ON CI.CHLDRN_NO = C.CHLDRN_NO WHERE ( SELECT M.MBER_NO FROM mber M WHERE M.MBER_ID = #{mberId} ) = MC.MBER_NO AND C.CHLDRN_DEL_AT = 'N' AND C.CHLDRN_HIDE_AT = 'N'
